title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has published its response to a report on Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards, outlining its approach to this issue. The response aims to address key concerns and recommendations made by the committee in their 2020 report.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education has established a policy for the use of generative artificial intelligence in education, guiding schools and teachers on its acceptable applications. The policy aims to balance education innovation with responsible AI use, ensuring students, teachers, and education data are treated fairly and transparently.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual is creating a policy to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications, responding to government requests for guidance. The purpose is to ensure AI is used in a safe and effective way in the qualifications sector.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report assesses the effects of using copyrighted materials in artificial intelligence development, exploring potential issues and implications. It examines how AI systems utilizing copyrighted works might impact copyright laws and creators' rights.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a report by the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, outlining plans to address the challenges and opportunities of AI in the country. The response aims to implement the committee's recommendations and ensure the UK benefits from AI advancements while mitigating its risks.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a committee reviewing AI and public standards. It likely covers the key goals, responsibilities, and questions the committee will address regarding artificial intelligence and its impact on public standards.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Centre for Science and Policy submitted written evidence to an inquiry on how to govern Artificial Intelligence. This submission aims to inform the inquiry and potentially shape policy around AI governance.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This document aims to discuss how Artificial Intelligence affects regulations around medical products. It involves implementing the principles of an Artificial Intelligence White Paper within the context of medical product regulation.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the defence organisation the most effective and efficient in the world using AI. Its vision is to establish the organisation as trusted and influential in the global defence sector using artificial intelligence.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines a plan by the Department for Transport (DfT) to harness the benefits of artificial intelligence in the transport sector. It aims to balance the advantages of AI with potential risks and challenges.
